Title: Backend API specifics for redesigned UI
Finding / Question: Backend API specifics required to support the redesigned UI: REST endpoints vs. GraphQL fields/mutations on EvalGraphQL, payload shape for the multi-session editor and per-session sub-dialogs.
Recommended Action: Define during Solution Design. APIs must be stateless and JWT-authenticated per teachpoint-web/CLAUDE.md.
Notes: Initiative scope includes 'supporting backend API components.'

Title: Pricing confirmation
Finding / Question: Pricing — included in base TeachPoint / EV+ package? No pricing-tier changes anticipated, but 'to be confirmed.'
Recommended Action: Confirm with Product leadership before release.

Title: Tenant communications ahead of toggle flip
Finding / Question: Do tenants relying on per-form custom-question logic need any communication ahead of the toggle flip?
Recommended Action: Surface visual differences early if they materially change tenant comms or training. Custom-question rendering is in scope.

Title: Rich-text Event Details editor — new library or carry-over
Finding / Question: Is the rich-text Event Details editor in scope of the new component library, or carried over from the Quill-based current implementation?
Recommended Action: Confirm component-library coverage during Solution Design. Today uses a Quill toolbar (bold/italic/underline/color/size/list/link, auto http:// link prefix).

Title: Full approver / reviewer action list
Finding / Question: Which approver/reviewer actions render in the new design — all current code-exposed actions (APPROVE, APPROVE_AS_CO, DECLINE, REVIEW, REVIEW_AS_CO, REVIEW_AS_EVALUATOR, RETURN_TO_AUTHOR) or a consolidated subset?
Recommended Action: UC3 + §2 Scope to be updated once UX confirms.
Notes: UC3 currently lists three actions only. Blocks B23.

Title: Read-only treatment for editable-vs-read-only fields
Finding / Question: Read-only and editable modes 'visually distinct beyond color' (UC3). Design treatment unresolved.
Recommended Action: UX to resolve read-only treatment (e.g., lock icon + aria-readonly='true' + reduced contrast, or another defensible pattern) before Stage 2.
Notes: B18 confirmed there is no separate read-only 'mode' — UX needs to confirm whether per-field disabled-state styling is sufficient. Cross-ref §6 read-only mode question.

Title: Permission-to-mode mapping + visual treatment
Finding / Question: UC5 AC: 'Edit-vs-read-only mode matches the user's permission set.' Testable only if permission-to-mode mapping is enumerated and visual mode indicator from B6 is resolved.
Recommended Action: Product to enumerate permission-to-mode mapping (e.g., isSectionEnabled() == false ? read-only; isAcceptedEditable() == true after acceptance ? editable); UX to confirm visual treatment with B6.
Notes: Pairs with B6.

Title: Program Attributes vs. Program Groups conflated
Finding / Question: §2 conflates Program Attributes and Program Groups as one section. Code has two separate rendering paths: Program___Attributes.xhtml renders eventattributes (event-level SINGLE_SELECT / MULTI_SELECT tied to a separate data model), while groups.xhtml iterates programGroups (the 8-type question system).
Recommended Action: Split §2 into two explicit subsections: (a) Event Attributes and (b) Custom Questions / Program Groups. Confirm data models and add separate ACs.
Notes: If treated as one component, one system breaks silently.

Title: Event copy / donor-event workflow unscoped
Finding / Question: Form supports a ?donorid={id} URL parameter. When active, EventActions.isCopiedEvent() returns true, donorEvent and donorAttendances load, and on Submit the copiedEventSubmitDialog asks 'Copy event attendees?'. Real creation path the PRD does not mention.
Recommended Action: Add to §2 Scope: When opened with a donorid parameter, form operates in copy mode; the donor-event Submit dialog must render correctly. Add a use-case AC.

Title: Selectable approver picker in action dialog
Finding / Question: The actionConfirmationDialog conditionally renders a p:selectOneMenu populated by eventEdit.getStepApprovalList(stepId) when nextApproval.selectableApprover == true. The acting user chooses who receives the next review step. PRD does not mention this picker.
Recommended Action: Add to §2 / UC3: When the current approval step has a selectable next approver, the action confirmation dialog renders an approver-selector dropdown; selection is required before action executes.
Notes: Approval routing breaks without it.

Title: Delete Approved Credits confirmation dialog
Finding / Question: When switching credit-assignment type during SAVE and previously approved credits exist, a special preventApprovedCreditsDialog warns the user. PRD §2 edge cases describe cascade behavior but not this destructive-data-loss confirmation path.
Recommended Action: Add to §2 Edge Cases: If a save action would change credit type and approved credits already exist, a confirmation dialog must warn the user; user must explicitly confirm before proceeding.
Notes: Data-loss path.

Title: Two permission-filter dialogs collapsed into one
Finding / Question: Form includes two independent permission editors: (1) PD Event Publishing access (permissionEdit, context PD_EVENT_PUBLISHING) and (2) Credit Editing access (pdEventCreditEditingPermissions). PRD §2 describes only 'PD Event Permissions' as a single feature.
Recommended Action: Update §2 to explicitly list two distinct permission dialogs with separate trigger affordances, backing beans, and IDs. Confirm distinct contexts and add AC for each.
Notes: If redesign renders one dialog, credit-editing permission management is lost.

Title: CANCEL and UNCANCEL actions absent
Finding / Question: Beyond DELETE_DRAFT (pre-submit drafts), accepted/published events can be Cancelled (distinct status transition) and then Un-cancelled. PRD §2 action-bar inventory omits both.
Recommended Action: Add CANCEL and UNCANCEL to §2 action-bar inventory with EventStateManager.Action triggers, confirmation requirements, and roles that can invoke them.

Title: Switched-user lockout not in scope
Finding / Question: EventStateManager.isNotSwitchedUser blocks all actions when an admin is impersonating another user. Form renders but no action buttons execute. If redesign does not replicate this gate, switched admins will be able to take actions on behalf of users.
Recommended Action: Add to §2 Constraints or Edge Cases: When an admin is operating as a switched user, all EventStateManager-gated actions are disabled. Form renders in view-only mode regardless of target user's permissions.

Title: Attendee Visibility field absent from inventory
Finding / Question: Radio group (HIDDEN / VISIBLE) controls whether event attendees can see each other in the roster. Renders for all non-individual programs within Scheduling Details. PRD §2 does not list this field.
Recommended Action: Add to §2 Scheduling Details (BASIC and ADVANCED): Attendee Visibility — radio (Hidden / Visible); renders for non-individual programs.
Notes: Will be silently dropped if not added.

Title: Individual privacy type field matrix not defined
Finding / Question: Significant conditional rendering applies when isIndividualPrivacyType is true: Max Attendees hidden, Presenters hidden, Enrollment Deadline hidden, Sign-up Approval hidden, Budget section enabled, events auto-accept. PRD never states which fields appear or disappear.
Recommended Action: Add field-visibility matrix to §2 (or appendix) enumerating fields shown/hidden per privacy type (Public / Restricted / Individual). Confirm via existing conditionals in groups.xhtml and Program___Scheduling.xhtml.
Notes: Wrong field set for individual events would be a regression.

Title: Evaluator Approval configuration section unscoped
Finding / Question: When eventEdit.program.approvals.size() > 0, a Program___Evaluator_Approval.xhtml section renders allowing evaluator assignment and step configuration. PRD mentions evaluator REVIEW action but not this form section.
Recommended Action: Add 'Evaluator Approval configuration' as a section in §2 scope with a conditional ('renders when program has one or more approval steps configured') and an AC covering evaluator assignment and step display.

Title: UNDELETE action absent from inventory
Finding / Question: Soft-deleted events can be un-deleted via the UNDELETE action. PRD §2 action-bar inventory does not include it.
Recommended Action: Add UNDELETE to §2 action-bar inventory with trigger condition and confirmation behavior.

Title: NOTIFY_AUTHOR (send message) action absent
Finding / Question: NOTIFY_AUTHOR is distinct from RETURN_TO_AUTHOR. Renders as a separate red button when eventActions.canSendMessage() is true, allowing an approver to message the author without changing event status.
Recommended Action: Add NOTIFY_AUTHOR as a separate action in §2 action-bar inventory with distinct trigger (canSendMessage()), button style (red), and confirmation-with-message dialog behavior.
Notes: Risk: merged with Return-to-Author in redesign.

Title: REIMBURSEMENT_APPROVE action absent
Finding / Question: EventStateManager.Action includes REIMBURSEMENT_APPROVE. PRD scopes the reimbursement fields but not the approval action that gates the reimbursement workflow.
Recommended Action: Add REIMBURSEMENT_APPROVE to §2 action-bar inventory with trigger condition and roles that can invoke it.

Title: Library / preview mode unscoped
Finding / Question: Form supports ?preview=1&pdlibrary=1 URL parameters that put it in a read-only preview mode for library/template events — distinct from approver read-only mode. PRD does not mention this access path.
Recommended Action: Add to §2 Scope: Form must preserve the preview=1&pdlibrary=1 URL-parameter mode, rendering read-only for library/template events with no action buttons.

Title: Predefined header section unscoped
Finding / Question: When predefinedHeader = true for a program type, a Program___Header.xhtml block with raw HTML renders at the top of the form before all other sections. PRD does not mention this conditional block.
Recommended Action: Add to §2 Scope: For program types with predefinedHeader = true, a program-defined HTML header block renders above all form sections; redesign must preserve this conditional block and its raw-HTML rendering.

Title: Per-slot feedback template unscoped
Finding / Question: In advanced scheduling, each slot row includes a Feedback Template dropdown rendered when event.multipleFeedback && (!event.new || !ONE_SLOT_signup). PRD §2 describes feedback only at the event level.
Recommended Action: Add to §2 ADVANCED schedule description: Each session row includes a Feedback Template dropdown when event has multiple feedback templates configured and signup type is not ONE_SLOT.

Title: Actual Cost gate condition misspecified
Finding / Question: PRD §2 says 'Actual Cost (post-approval)' implying a time gate. Code gates on eventBudgetEdit.attendanceApproved == true — a permission/state gate; field is hidden entirely until attendance is approved.
Recommended Action: Correct §2 Budget section: Actual Cost field renders only when attendanceApproved = true; not visible before attendance approval regardless of event status.

Title: Enrollment Deadline in wrong section
Finding / Question: PRD §2 places Enrollment Deadline in 'Author / Approval Controls.' Code renders it within Scheduling Details (both BASIC and ADVANCED).
Recommended Action: Move the Enrollment Deadline field specification from 'Author / Approval Controls' to 'Scheduling Details' in §2.
Notes: Wrong section produces incorrect component tree.

Title: Author Can Edit per-event checkboxes unscoped
Finding / Question: For individual privacy programs, form renders per-event checkboxes for AuthorCanEditOption values (ENROLLMENT_DEADLINE, SIGN_UP, FEEDBACK, EVIDENCE, CREDIT_EDITING). These are per-event author overrides, not admin-level program settings.
Recommended Action: Add to §2: For individual privacy programs, form renders per-event Author Can Edit checkboxes that allow author to control which settings they may edit on this event. Add corresponding AC.

Title: Full event status vocabulary not enumerated
Finding / Question: PRD §2 gives 'e.g., DRAFT, PENDING, ACCEPTED' as examples. Actual status keys include PENDING_CO_APPROVAL, WAITING_REVIEW_EVALUATOR, INCOMPLETE, DELETED, CANCELLED, and others. Status pill must render correct label for every status.
Recommended Action: Enumerate the complete set of event.status.key values expected in the status pill (derivable from EventStateManager state transitions) and add to §2 or appendix.

Title: Evidence Requirement section has no AC
Finding / Question: §2 mentions Evidence Requirement in scope list (None / Optional / Required + viewable by Administrator / By Presenter) but no use case includes an AC covering its rendering, persistence, or read-only display.
Recommended Action: Add an AC to UC1 or UC4: Evidence Requirement renders with options None / Optional / Required; when Required, the 'Viewable by' sub-option (Administrator / By Presenter) renders correctly in edit and read-only modes.

Title: skipValidation list missing CANCEL and NOTIFY_AUTHOR
Finding / Question: PRD §2 lists SAVE_DRAFT, DELETE_DRAFT, RETURN_TO_AUTHOR, CLOSE, and UNDELETE as actions that skip validation. Code also skips validation for CANCEL and NOTIFY_AUTHOR.
Recommended Action: Add CANCEL and NOTIFY_AUTHOR to the skip-validation action list in §2.
Notes: QA will expect (and test for) validation on actions that should bypass it.

Title: Attendees sub-dialog also exists in BASIC mode
Finding / Question: PRD §2 mentions 'per-session Max Attendees / Waitlist sub-dialog' in the ADVANCED section, implying it is session-specific. The same attendeesSubDialog is used in BASIC mode to edit single-slot attendee limits.
Recommended Action: Update §2 BASIC schedule description to include the Max Attendees / Waitlist sub-dialog affordance, clarifying it exists in both schedule modes.

Title: Tags-browser dialog UX
Finding / Question: What is the UX for the tags-browser dialog (selection panel, persistence flow, read-only display)?
Recommended Action: UX flow design and final UI surface to be resolved before that future step ships. Backend build supports tags now; UI surface deferred.
Notes: Referred from §7.A.

Title: By-Presenter approval guard pattern
Finding / Question: What pattern surfaces the By-Presenter approval guard (when no presenters are registered) so it is accessible and verifiable — accessible inline error, disabled checkbox with help text, or another pattern?
Recommended Action: UX to specify so QA can write a verifiable AC.
Notes: Today implemented as a JS confirm dialog (accessibility issue).

Title: Per-session persistence baseline
Finding / Question: Per-session overrides 'persist exactly as today' (UC2). 'As today' requires a documented baseline that the PRD does not include.
Recommended Action: Product to confirm whether to freeze persistence baseline now (field-by-field) or defer to a Phase 1 regression-suite baseline.

Title: Printer-friendly rendering rules (cross-cutting)
Finding / Question: All PD Event Forms must be printer friendly. Cross-cutting AC — applies to all five use cases. Current page does not ship with a print-optimized stylesheet.
Recommended Action: UX to specify: (a) how form values render in print (selected dropdown / radio / checkbox values as readable text); (b) which interactive affordances are suppressed (Add Session, Edit Session, sticky action bar, drag-and-drop attachment zone); (c) page-break behavior (avoid breaking session-grid rows, logical groupings); (d) color / contrast / background handling rules.
Notes: New requirement added 2026-04-28. Originally tracked as A18 in second PRD, renumbered to avoid collision with Sunil's A18.

Title: Support-ticket reduction quantitative target
Finding / Question: Success metric 'reduction in support tickets' has no quantitative target.
Recommended Action: Product to set a quantitative delta (e.g., ?15% reduction in event-form support tickets in 90 days post- vs. pre-release).
Notes: §4 Success Metrics.

Title: Form-completion drop-off / error-rate target
Finding / Question: Success metric 'form-completion drop-off / error rate improvement' has no quantitative target.
Recommended Action: Product to set a quantitative delta (e.g., ?10% reduction in error-banner views per Save-click event).
Notes: §4 Success Metrics.

Title: NPS commentary movement target
Finding / Question: Success metric 'positive movement in NPS commentary' has no quantitative target.
Recommended Action: Product to set quantitative delta (e.g., ?20% reduction in negative usability mentions in NPS verbatim) and confirm sample size sufficient to call it.
Notes: §4 Success Metrics.

Title: Save success-rate baseline approach
Finding / Question: Success metric 'Save Draft / Save / Submit success rate equal to or better than current rate' — current rate is not captured anywhere.
Recommended Action: Product to confirm baseline-capture approach (server-log window, telemetry definition). Likely a Phase 1 prerequisite to capture current rates from server logs over a defined pre-release window.
Notes: §4 Success Metrics.

Title: General error-state pattern
Finding / Question: Edge case: 'A general error state is displayed; recovery path detailed in Solution Design.' QA cannot regression-test without knowing message text, trigger conditions, recovery affordance, or whether form state is preserved.
Recommended Action: Product to specify the error pattern (message text, trigger conditions, recovery affordance, form-state preservation) or formally defer to Stage 3 with a documented handoff.
Notes: §2 Edge Cases.

Title: Credits Assigned × User Sign-up truth table
Finding / Question: Credits Assigned + User Sign-up radios update grid columns and validation 'correctly' (UC2) — what columns appear/disappear? Which validations toggle?
Recommended Action: UX to provide truth table of grid shape and validation rules per (CreditsAssigned, UserSignUp) combination so a verifiable AC can be written.
Notes: Needed to write a verifiable AC for UC2.

Title: Non-color affordance for accessibility
Finding / Question: Edge case: 'Color-only treatment is insufficient for accessibility' — guideline, not an AC.
Recommended Action: UX to operationalize the non-color affordance (e.g., lock icon + aria-readonly='true').
Notes: Aligns with B6.

Title: Character limit enforcement UX
Finding / Question: PRD states numeric char limits but not the enforcement UX. Code enforces via client-side .maxchar{N} CSS classes + a PrimeFaces popup alert the user must dismiss. QA cannot test an unspecified enforcement pattern.
Recommended Action: Specify: Character limits enforced client-side; when limit reached, input is clamped and a dismissible alert is displayed. QA verifies enforcement at 512, 1024, 10000, and 20000 chars; exact enforcement UI (inline vs. modal alert) confirmed in Stage 2.

Title: 'Varies by time slot' — fields not enumerated
Finding / Question: PRD states the 'varies by time slot' pattern must be preserved but does not enumerate which fields trigger it or the exact triggering condition. QA cannot verify coverage without a field list.
Recommended Action: Enumerate: 'Varies by time slot' label replaces the editable input for Title, Location, Max Attendees, Credits, and Presenters when SlotSet reports diverging values across sessions. QA verifies by creating sessions with diverging values for each of the five fields.

Title: All approver actions reachable via keyboard
Finding / Question: Extends B3. Full approver action set is not enumerated (see A16, A23, A28–A30); keyboard-reachability cannot be verified without complete list.
Recommended Action: Block this AC on resolution of A16 + all new action-inventory items (A23, A28–A30). Replace 'all approver actions' with the enumerated set once those items are resolved.
Notes: Blocked on A16, A23, A28, A29, A30.

Title: Add Presenter dialog UX spec
Finding / Question: The dialog is a two-panel split: left = single-presenter edit form (Vector user autocomplete with min-3-char trigger OR free-text Other presenter), right = added-presenter list with delete. PRD mentions only 'Add Presenter dialog' with no UX spec.
Recommended Action: Specify: (a) Left panel: Presenter Type toggle (Vector User / Other); Vector User path: autocomplete with ? 3 chars, displays name/school/job/subject/grade/dept/email/phone; Other path: name/email/phone text fields. (b) Right panel: added-presenter list with per-row delete. Confirm against Stage 2 mock.

Title: Negative budget balance — color-only WCAG conflict
Finding / Question: Budget summary includes remaining balance that renders in red when negative. Color-only indicator conflicts with WCAG 2.1 AA SC 1.4.1.
Recommended Action: Specify: Remaining balance renders in red AND with a non-color indicator (e.g., parentheses, minus-sign prefix, or icon) when negative. WCAG SC 1.4.1 compliance is part of the accessible-budget-summary AC.
Notes: Direct WCAG conflict.

Title: Return to Author dialog — two checkboxes conflated
Finding / Question: PRD conflates two separately optional elements: (1) the comment message textarea and (2) the email notification. In code, the textarea appears only when a checkbox is checked; notifyUser is the separate notification toggle.
Recommended Action: Clarify: Return to Author confirmation dialog contains (a) an optional 'Add message' checkbox; when checked a message textarea renders; (b) a separate 'Notify user' checkbox that triggers the email notification. Both are independently optional and independently testable.

Title: 'Add Event Details' closed state behavior
Finding / Question: PRD references the closed state as one of the 7 source-of-truth mocks but does not specify: (a) what triggers collapse/expand, (b) whether collapsed is the default state, (c) whether the expanded/collapsed state persists.
Recommended Action: Specify: (a) Event Details rich-text block defaults to collapsed when eventDetailsVisible == false; (b) expanding sets eventDetailsVisible = true and persists for the session; (c) QA verifies collapsed default on a new event and expanded default on an event that already has Event Details content.

Title: Schedule Type AJAX update-region semantics
Finding / Question: Schedule Type toggle fires AJAX updates on named regions (slottingWrapper, scheduleSettingsPanel, creditsSettingsPanel, optionally feedbackSettings). Redesign must replicate these update-region semantics but PRD does not name them.
Recommended Action: Add a Stage 3 entry criterion: 'AJAX update-region contract for Schedule Type switching is documented — either as named React state slices or as a component-tree specification — before implementation begins.'
Notes: Risk of component-ID coupling.
